annotations.exact_quote: The goal of semisupervised kernel matrix learning (SS-KML) is to learn a kernel matrix on all the given samples on which just a little supervised information, such as class label or pairwise constraint, is provided.
annotations.reason_zh: 标题与摘要明确为半监督核矩阵学习，利用少量类别标签或成对约束监督全体样本，符合有限监督与未标注样本结合的定义。

annotations.exact_quote: just a little supervised information, such as class label or pairwise constraint, is provided
annotations.reason_zh: 使用少量类别标签或成对约束作为有限且不完整的监督信号来学习全体样本的核矩阵，符合以有限标注替代充分实例级真值的弱监督设定。

annotations.exact_quote: learn a kernel matrix on all the given samples
annotations.reason_zh: 在全体给定样本上学习核矩阵，核矩阵编码样本间相似/亲和关系，属于学习样本间亲和矩阵。
